description: Change an existing booking — reschedule (eventId or startTime/endTime), change participant counts, options, resources or external reference. Fetches the current booking and sends it back with only your changes applied (Bookeo's PUT takes the full booking). Bookeo: GET then PUT /bookings/{bookingNumber}.

endTime.description: New end time (flexibleTime) — RFC 3339 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00-04:00. The offset -00:00 means the account's local timezone.

eventId.description: New slot id (reschedule a fixed/fixedCourse booking).

mode.description: Set to "backend" to act as a manager, relaxing customer-facing limits (time in advance, participant limits, change windows).

notifyCustomer.description: Email the customer about the change.

notifyUsers.description: Email/SMS the business's staff about the change.

name.description: Option name, as an alternative to id.

value.description: Option value: "true"/"false" for on/off options, a number as a string, the chosen value's name, or free text.

peopleNumbers.description: New participant counts per category (replaces the current ones).

number.description: How many people of this category.

peopleCategoryId.description: People category id, e.g. Cadults, Cchildren, Cinfants or a custom id (see bookeo_list_people_categories).

resources.description: Resources (e.g. a specific guide or instructor) — for flexibleTime products.

startTime.description: New start time (flexibleTime) — RFC 3339 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00-04:00. The offset -00:00 means the account's local timezone.

name: bookeo_update_booking
title: Update a booking
